    FROM "UserFavorites" AS "u0"
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT "b2"."Id", "b2"."IsDeleted"
        FROM "Books" AS "b2"
        WHERE NOT ("b2"."IsDeleted")
    ) AS "b3" ON "u0"."BookId" = "b3"."Id"
    WHERE NOT ("b3"."IsDeleted") AND NOT ("u0"."IsDeleted")
) AS "s" ON "b4"."Id" = "s"."BookId1"
ORDER BY "b4"."c" DESC, "b4"."Id", "s"."Id"
